---
name: meeting-notes
description: Summarizes meetings into structured minutes. Use when the user has meeting transcripts.
---

# Meeting Notes

1. Read the transcript file provided by the user.
2. Extract decisions, action items and owners.
3. Output minutes as Markdown with three sections: Summary, Decisions, Actions.

Example output:

## Summary
Weekly sync on the release plan.

## Decisions
- Ship v2 on Friday.

## Actions
- Alice: finalize the changelog.
